sections.heading: What is Credit?
sections.text: Credit is borrowed money used to purchase goods or services, to be repaid later with interest.

sections.heading: What is Debt?
sections.text: Debt is the total amount owed after borrowing money.

sections.heading: Types of Credit
sections.text:
- Credit cards
- Personal loans
- Student loans
- Mortgages

sections.heading: How Credit Works
sections.text:
You borrow → use → repay with interest.

Includes principal and interest.

sections.heading: Credit Score
sections.text:
A number representing your creditworthiness.
Higher score = better loan terms.

sections.heading: Good vs Bad Debt
sections.text:
Good debt: education, business
Bad debt: unnecessary spending

sections.heading: Risks
sections.text:
- Debt trap
- High interest
- Financial stress

sections.heading: Smart Tips
sections.text:
- Pay on time
- Avoid excess borrowing
- Maintain low credit usage
